newsitem.title: USA: Scattered 2-4 cts protection posted on HRW wheat.
newsitem.headline: Scattered 2-4 cts protection posted on HRW wheat.

text.p: Dealers in Kansas and Oklahoma reported posting scattered two to four cents per bushel protection on new crop hard red winter wheat ahead of an expected lower opening on KCBT futures.
Also, isolated four to five cents protection was taken on old crop wheat.
One Kansas dealer reported heavy producer selling of new crop in his area but in most other locations activity was subdued.

KCBT new crop wheat futures were seen opening lower on spillover selling from an expected sharp drop in CBOT new crop soybeans following bearish wheat acreage data issued earlier Monday by the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
